name: Whole-run ATWI
description: ATWI workload percentage calculated over the full simulation recording duration.
method: Read from ATWI recording analysis result.

name: Average window ATWI
description: The average of binned ATWI percentages calculated across all simulation time windows.
method: Calculate mean of binned time-series ATWI values.

name: Peak ATWI
description: The maximum workload value observed in any single simulation window.
method: Identify maximum value in ATWI timeseries.

name: Peak workload band
description: The highest workload band observed (NORMAL, WATCH, HIGH, or CRITICAL) during simulation run.
method: Determine highest severity binned workload band.

name: Critical workload windows
description: Number of analysis windows where calculated ATWI workload exceeded the CRITICAL threshold (typically >= 90%).
method: Count binned time windows flagged as CRITICAL workload.

name: High workload windows
description: Number of analysis windows where workload fell into the HIGH band (typically 75% to 90%).
method: Count binned time windows flagged as HIGH workload.

name: Unique aircraft count
description: The total number of unique aircraft callsigns tracked in the trajectory logs.
method: Count unique callsign occurrences in trajectory records.

name: Track sample count
description: The total count of trajectory updates recorded throughout the simulation.
method: Perform a line count of trajectory updates.

name: Run duration
description: The total span of simulation time from start to end.
method: Determine the temporal range of simulation timestamps.

name: Average active aircraft
description: The mean number of aircraft simultaneously present in the airspace during any binned minute.
method: Bin trajectories into 60-second windows and compute average active traffic density.

name: Peak active aircraft
description: The maximum count of concurrent active aircraft in any single minute bin.
method: Bin trajectories and identify the peak concurrent aircraft count.

name: Conflict event count
description: The aggregate count of conflict warning occurrences recorded in the simulation.
method: Count separate entries within separation conflict logs.

name: Critical conflict count
description: Count of conflicts where aircraft separation violated the minimum critical safety standard.
method: Count separation warning entries labeled with critical safety severity.

name: Warning conflict count
description: Count of conflicts flagged with standard safety warning or alert status.
method: Count separation warning entries labeled with warning safety severity.

name: Minimum horizontal separation
description: The absolute minimum horizontal separation distance observed between conflict pairs.
method: Extract smallest horizontal distance from conflict records.

name: Minimum vertical separation
description: The absolute minimum vertical separation distance observed between conflict pairs.
method: Extract smallest vertical distance from conflict records.

name: Total commands sent
description: The count of tactical ATC intervention instructions sent to simulator aircraft.
method: Perform an entry count of the controller command logs.

name: Initialization commands
description: Count of IC (Initialize Command) commands executed in the simulation run.
method: Count occurrences of initialization inputs.

name: Vector / Direct instructions
description: Count of heading changes, direct routings, or manual turns commanded to simulated aircraft.
method: Parse command text patterns for direct, turn, or heading keywords.

name: Altitude changes
description: Count of climb, descent, or vertical profile adjustments issued.
method: Parse command text patterns for altitude or vertical level keywords.

name: Speed profile commands
description: Count of tactical speed restrictions or cruise mach adjustments.
method: Parse command text patterns for velocity, knots, or mach keywords.

name: Trajectory file availability
description: Confirms the existence and validity of the trajectory track file.
method: Check file system path for replay track file.

name: Event log availability
description: Confirms simulation event logging availability.
method: Check file system path for event log file.

name: Command log availability
description: Confirms tactical controller input logging availability.
method: Check file system path for command log file.

name: Conflict log availability
description: Confirms separation violation log file availability.
method: Check file system path for conflict log file.

name: ATWI result availability
description: Confirms workload index result exists inside recording outcomes.
method: Check file system path for ATWI workload result.

name: Data warning count
description: Aggregated count of logging parse errors or minor anomalies detected during analysis.
method: Audit log structural completeness and count minor parsing anomalies.

name: Replay module compatibility
description: Confirms if this simulation recording dataset is successfully loadable by the Replay engine.
method: Evaluate if replay component satisfies load constraints.

name: Replay range span
description: Duration span of recorded flight track update timestamps.
method: Compute absolute span of flight updates.
